mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 70 degrees at Harriet Park with overcast skies and a waning gibbous moon. The ISS will be visible at 3:29 AM, rising over Verona High School and traveling toward the Madison area near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 69 degrees, and keep your umbrella handy as rain is predicted.

Mayor Luke Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to address food insecurity, which impacts 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin. The city is calling on residents to volunteer and advocate to help ensure everyone in our community has enough to eat.

There is plenty happening in Verona. Today, enjoy Live Music at Bailey's Run, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, and the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, consider joining a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local police activity, on August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street at Bering Drive where minor injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
